default_behaviour_changes.name: `alwan_lut3d_invert_{T}` stalled outside the forward cube's image.
F16 pixel buffers were written by truncation.
The Sigma SDMerill (NPL) camera responded outside its measured range.
JP2499 did not clamp its input to the half-float range.
Four ACES 1.x presets did not follow their ODTs.
The scalar ACES 2.0 forward skipped the Academy's input clamp.
The dim surround of CIECAM02, CAM16, CIECAM16 and Kim 2009 used Nc 0.95.
Hunt's dark surround was the light-box row.
Hunt's proximal-field term p was not Hunt's formula.
ACES 2.0 gamut compression built its cusp table its own way.
AP1 limiting primaries were taken as a pass-through.
Jakob 2019 upsampling read a resampled table, and missed black and the dark end.
ADX10 and ADX16 had the wrong scale and offset.
The ACES 2.0 cinema presets were not ACES 2.0.
The CMYK inverse returned ALWAN_OK with uninitialised inks for a NaN Lab.
`alwan_csf_{T}` was not Barten's model.
`alwan_metamerism_index_{T}` ignored its reference illuminant.
alwan_gamut_map_advanced_{T} methods 2 to 7 did not compute what they were named.
The gamut mappers' linear sRGB working space had a white of (0.31271, 0.32902)
Deterministic builds were not deterministic for 43 families.
`ALWAN_VIEW_TONY_MCMAPFACE` was not Tony McMapface.
`ALWAN_VIEW_LOTTES` applied Lottes's curve to the largest channel
The ACES `sigmoid_shaper` stepped in the wrong place.
`alwan_aces_redmod03_{T}` skipped its hue restoration
The ACES 1.x SDR inverse output transform failed near black.
`alwan_table_interp_3d_trilinear_{T}` and `_tetrahedral_{T}` returned `ALWAN_E_RANGE` for a NULL pointer
`alwan_simulate_cvd_{T}` was not Brettel 1997.
`alwan_delta_e_hyab_{T}` was not HyAB.
`alwan_llab_forward_{T}` returned NaN for very dark samples.
`alwan_srgb_to_okhsl_{T}` and `alwan_srgb_to_okhsv_{T}` gave greys a saturation.
`alwan_apca_contrast_{T}` returned NaN or a number where APCA-W3 returns 0.
`alwan_mesopic_luminance_{T}` was not CIE 191:2010.
`alwan_photopic_luminance_{T}` and `alwan_scotopic_luminance_{T}` held V and V' at their end values outside the tables.
CAM18sl was not the published model.
CAM20u's round trip was 27.5 % off, and its reference did not exist.
BT.2446 Method A was not the Report's.
BT.2446 Method C was not the Report's.
`alwan_bt2390_eetf_{T}` left out the black lift and normalised the target wrongly.
Munsell both ways was a nearest-neighbour lookup.
`ALWAN_INTERP_SPRAGUE` and `ALWAN_INTERP_AKIMA` were not those interpolators.
`alwan_ssi_calculate_{T}` was up to 1.5 SSI off colour-science.
RLAB clamped colours outside its reference gamut.
`alwan_ncs_to_xyz_{T}` refused every standard NCS notation.
The HLG OOTF clamped a negative luminance.
`alwan_aces2_output_transform_inv_{T}` did not invert the ACES 2.0 output transform.
CQS and TM-30 now compute what colour-science computes.
`ALWAN_MORPHOLOGY_AREA_OPEN`, `AREA_CLOSE`, `DIAMETER_OPEN` and `DIAMETER_CLOSE` ran the skeleton.
CSS Color 4 gamut mapping collapsed chroma toward grey.
The HCL inverse map returned the wrong red channel for pixels with R == G.
`ALWAN_TONEMAP_REINHARD2004`'s global adaptation level takes the paper's arithmetic means.
ZCAM was wrong, forward and inverse, and had never been tested.
The OSA-UCS inverse was an approximation with invented coefficients.
Zhai 2018 scaled with its destination white.
Dominant wavelength and excitation purity were wrong for purples.
V(lambda) and V'(lambda) were 10 nm tables.
The deterministic BT.709 and BT.2020 curves split at the wrong side of 0.018.
An unknown integration method ran Simpson's rule.
The f32 Finlayson 2015 fit wrote past its buffers.
TM-30 Rf and the CQS colour differences were wrong at the shipped
The .cube reader accepted infinities and NaN.
The CCM fits solved through the normal equations and lost most of their precision doing it.
The bulk paths ignored `ALWAN_NORMALIZE_RANGES` for some spaces and honoured it for others.
The deterministic sRGB and BT.2020 OETF returned garbage above 1.0.
`ALWAN_FIT_LOCK_SCALE` and `ALWAN_FIT_LOCK_TF` did not hold their value.
YcCbcCrc double-offset its chroma in a default build.
The ACES 1.x HDR outputs are the ACES 1.1 to 1.3 transforms.
RGB-space transfer functions audited against colour-science.
Eight transfer functions the library did not have
`alwan_rgb_space_get_tfs` answers for every space.
TM-30 Rf took the CCT on the wrong observer.
`alwan_video_encode_{T}` and `alwan_video_decode_{T}` accepted a deeper bit depth on a U8 buffer.
`alwan_xyz_to_spectrum_meng2015` read through a caller's illuminant unchecked.
Float-to-index casts that NaN, inf or a far value could reach.
Every CLF alwan exported with a view transform had its 3D LUT transposed.
The experimental RGB fit could read past a buffer.
The hue quadrature was wrong, in CIECAM02 and in CAM16.
The SIMD maps no longer pay SVML's special-value tax on black and out-of-gamut pixels.
The ACES 1.x tone curves stop recomputing their constants per channel.
The CIECAM02 and CAM16 maps compute the viewing-condition terms once per call.
`alwan_oetf_apply_f32` and `alwan_eotf_apply_f32` have a vector path.
Interop IDs are the Color Interop Forum's published ones.
`ALWAN_NORMALIZE_RANGES` is documented as a library build switch.
The single-pass GPU backends get the whole deterministic layer, including the angle family.
`ALWAN_DETERMINISTIC` now reaches the header-only core, which it did not.
Planck's law: the zero-denominator guard was dead in single precision.
`alwan_half_core.h` includes the header defining `ALWAN_MEMCPY`.
The Hunt forward agrees with colour-science to `2.8e-14`, not `4.6e-08`.
Deterministic `log2` is a minimax fit of `log2(m)/(m-1)`, not of `log2(m)`.
The sRGB and BT.2020 transfer functions drop their own polynomials for `alwan_det_pow_pos`.
`alwan_create` refuses a configuration that cannot be meant.
`alwan_color_checker_num_patches` reports what alwan can hand you.
Experimental RGB space fit
The deterministic angle family
Const placement is a rule now, and gated in CI.
